fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3309500 (esv::TimelineSystem, handler of the 'player watching dialog timeline' protocol message; calls ~LSDialogs::DialogManager::SetIsPlayerWatchingDialogTimeline) creates the component on a new entity (bg3.exe+0x3312260) and copies the 4 bytes at the start of the request, whose low 16 bits it has just compared with the peer part of the character's user id (esv::Character +0x188). bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 (~esv::timeline::FadeSystem::ProcessClearScreenFades) uses it as the 4-byte key of its per-user map (system +0x10). Live: 0x10001 = user 65537 (the host).
